   Make auto mode your default permission mode?

   Auto mode lets Claude handle permission prompts automatically — Claude checks each tool call for risky actions and prompt
   injection before executing. You can change this any time with Shift+Tab or /permissions.

   ❯ 1. Yes, make auto mode my default
     2. No, not now

   Enter to confirm · Esc to cancel
